senses.gloss:
m. (-ञ्चः)
The name of a mountain, part of the Himāla range: see क्रौञ्च.

f. (-नी)
1 The wife of a Brahman or any venerable personage.
2 A female descendant of Kuñja.
E.
कुञ्ज, and फक् affix, fem. affix ङीष्; this word may be masculine, कौञ्जायन m. (-नः) meaning a male descendant of Kuñja; also कैञ्जायन्य formed from कुञ्ज by च्यञ् affix m. sing. (-न्यः) sense; also plur. (-नाः).
